fields.old: Bedrock (Regalia). Presence-only -- the 75%-of-base floor on a Defense reduction is bespoke math in effectivePlayerDef, not a generic add/multiply.
fields.new: Bedrock (Regalia). Floors a Defense reduction at 75% of unreduced base.

fields.old: Timeless Guard. Presence-only -- the cooldown-gated full block is applyTimelessGuard's own logic (combat.js).
fields.new: Timeless Guard. Cooldown ticked by tickModifierCooldown, called from the same per-round tick site the old combat.player.timelessGuardCooldown field used.

new.line: Timeless Guard — for a moment, time itself refuses to let the blow land.

fields.old: Guardian Spirit. Presence-only -- the once-per-fight full block is pipeline.js rollToHit's own logic.

new.line: Guardian Spirit turns the first blow aside completely.

fields.old: Guided Footsteps. Presence-only -- the once-per-fight 75%-chance block is pipeline.js rollToHit's own logic.

new.line: Guided Footsteps — you're already a step from where it lands.

fields.old: Never Where Expected. Presence-only -- the flat 15% miss chance (every hit, not once-per-fight) is pipeline.js rollToHit's own logic. Corrected in the 2a catalogue's REVIEW pass: previously miscatalogued as rollToHit.attacker.
fields.new: Never Where Expected. Flat chance every hit, no once-per-fight gate. Corrected in the 2a catalogue's REVIEW pass: previously miscatalogued as rollToHit.attacker.

new.line: Never Where Expected — it swings, and finds nothing there.

fields.old: Blessing of Freedom. Presence-only -- the flat 15% miss chance is pipeline.js rollToHit's own logic.
fields.new: Blessing of Freedom. Same behavior as Never Where Expected, reused rather than redefined.

new.line: Blessing of Freedom carries you clear of the blow.

fields.old: Evasive Guard (kind B, asymmetry register). Presence-only -- read inside rollToHit's own evasion-triggered branch; the +1 Defense stack it grants (up to +3) is a separate accumulator field (combat.player.evasiveGuardBonus), 2b/2e territory, not touched here.
fields.new: Evasive Guard (kind B, asymmetry register). Fires only once an evasion has already succeeded; grants +1 Defense per success, capped +3. effectivePlayerDef reads this entry's own state.stacks instead of the old combat.player.evasiveGuardBonus field.

fields.old: River Warden 6pc. Presence-only -- read inside rollToHit's own evasion-triggered branch, gated on the incoming hit being magical (creature.element); the +2 Magic stack it grants (up to +8) is a separate accumulator field (combat.player.riverWardenMagicBonus), not touched here.
fields.new: River Warden 6pc. Same behavior as Evasive Guard, gated additionally on the incoming hit being magical. Grants +2 Magic per success, capped +8. The player's own Magic total reads this entry's own state.stacks instead of the old combat.player.riverWardenMagicBonus field.
